# Added "learn/mmi" Documentation

Date: 2026-01-07

## Summary
Created a new MMI documentation section under `docs/learn/mmi/` covering physics, design rules, numerical implementation in HELIOS, usage examples, and validation tips. Content is concise and includes key formulas with plain-English explanations.

## Files Added
- `docs/learn/mmi/index.md` — Landing page and navigation
- `docs/learn/mmi/physics.md` — Physical principles (self-imaging, beat length, cutoff, V-number)
- `docs/learn/mmi/design.md` — Practical design rules (length, port placement, modal regime)
- `docs/learn/mmi/numerics.md` — Implementation details (mode basis, propagation, coupling, calibration)
- `docs/learn/mmi/usage.md` — Code snippets for simulate and calibrations
- `docs/learn/mmi/validation.md` — Sanity checks and diagnostics

## Notes
- Formulas mirror the approximations used in code (e.g., `L_pi ≈ 4 n_eff W^2 / (3 λ)`).
- No changes to code behavior; this is documentation only.
- Consider linking this section from the main docs index if desired.
